sections.description:
Tiny SEO is a simple, lightweight plugin. A few easy settings give each page the SEO that matters most: SEO titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph and X Card tags, structured data and a clean sitemap. There is no scoring, no dashboard, no upsell and no setup wizard. One meta box on the edit screen and one settings page are all there is.

It builds on what WordPress already does. The sitemap is the WordPress core sitemap (wp-sitemap.xml). Robots directives are added to the robots meta tag that WordPress itself prints, and the canonical URL is the one WordPress prints, so a page never ends up with two of either. By default the SEO description is saved as the post excerpt, so what you write stays on your site even if you stop using the plugin.

What you can set for each post

  • SEO title, with an option to remove the site name from the title tag
  • SEO description (meta description)
  • Canonical URL
  • noindex, nofollow (the post is also removed from the sitemap)

The meta box shows a search result preview for desktop and mobile, and character counters for the title and the description.

What it outputs

  • Title tag – the SEO title when you have set one. Archives, search results and the 404 page keep the WordPress default.
  • Meta description – on posts and pages that have a description, on category and tag archives that have a description, and on the front page (the site tagline when it has no description of its own). It is never generated from the post content.
  • Robots – noindex for author archives and date archives (each can be turned off), post format archives and the 404 page. Tag archives can be set to noindex as well.
  • Open Graph and X (Twitter) Card tags – title, description, URL, site name, image and article dates. The image is the featured image, or the default image you choose on the settings page.
  • JSON-LD structured data – WebSite and Organization on the front page, Article on posts, and BreadcrumbList (can be turned off).
  • Sitemap tweaks – removes noindexed posts and post format archives, the users sitemap when author archives are noindexed, and tags when tag archives are noindexed. Adds the last modified date to posts and terms.

Works with what you already have

  • While Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO is active, Tiny SEO outputs nothing and hides its meta box, so tags are never duplicated. It starts working when you deactivate the other plugin.
  • You can import titles, descriptions, noindex flags, canonical URLs and some settings from Yoast SEO and Jetpack SEO with a button on the settings page. The original data is not deleted, and values you have already changed in Tiny SEO are not overwritten.
  • After you leave Yoast SEO, requests for its old sitemap URLs (such as /sitemap_index.xml) are redirected to the WordPress core sitemap.
  • When Jetpack is active, its Open Graph tags and Twitter Cards are turned off to avoid duplicates.

What it does not do

Content analysis and readability scores, redirect management, SEO fields for categories and tags, and per-archive images are out of scope.

Small footprint

Tiny SEO loads no JavaScript or CSS on the front end; its scripts are used only on the edit screen and the settings page. It creates no database tables and runs no scheduled tasks. Its data is one settings option and a few post meta fields.

Privacy

Tiny SEO does not track anything and sets no cookies. To check for updates, it requests a small file (info.json) from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com), where the plugin is distributed. The request does not include your site's URL or any site data. It makes no other external requests.

For theme developers

Themes can reuse the data Tiny SEO works with:

  • tiny_seo_get_breadcrumb_items() – the breadcrumb trail used for BreadcrumbList, for rendering visible breadcrumbs
  • tiny_seo_get_description(), tiny_seo_get_summary(), tiny_seo_get_image()
  • tiny_seo_is_active() – whether Tiny SEO is currently outputting tags

Filters: tiny_seo_default_image, tiny_seo_breadcrumb_items, tiny_seo_meta_box_post_types, tiny_seo_article_type, tiny_seo_json_ld_graph, tiny_seo_og_tags.

0.1.5

  • Added an update checker. New versions now appear on the Plugins screen and can be installed from there.
  • The Japanese translation is bundled with the plugin again.

0.1.4

  • Added the meta description to the front page and to category and tag archives, and an option to set tag archives to noindex.
